summary: @apexfdn/apex postinstall downloads and executes binary from unrelated GitHub org
details: The npm package @apexfdn/apex ships an install.cjs postinstall script that downloads a platform-specific executable (and on Windows a native.node addon) from github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot at a hardcoded release tag v1.0.0, writes the binary into the package's bin/ directory with mode 0755 and into ~/.apex/natives/, and then the shipped bin/apex wrapper spawns that binary. The download source organization (Apex-Foundation/copilot) does not match the package's declared publisher metadata: package.json points at repository can1357/oh-my-pi and homepage omp.sh, and the README describes @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent. The fetched release tag is not tied to the npm package version, and no hash, signature, or integrity check is performed on the downloaded bytes. Whoever controls the Apex-Foundation/copilot GitHub releases can therefore serve arbitrary executable content that runs on every machine that installs @apexfdn/apex.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
